summary: Senti Biosciences Holdings, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) relating to an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $17.5 million in common stock through Leerink Partners. The filing primarily discloses a holding-company reorganization under DGCL Section 251(g), where the predecessor merged into a subsidiary of the new holding company, resulting in a one-for-one share conversion with no material change in assets, business, or operations. The ATM program continues under the successor. Approximately $6.0 million remained unsold as of the filing date. This is a routine shelf takedown and corporate redomestication, not a special situation.
